'''Kovor''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where a [[Battle above Kovor|battle]] occurred during the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], which the latter won thanks to the intervention of the [[Coruscant Aegis]] squadron.<ref name="Kovor Ice Field">{{TORcite|type=space|Kovor Ice Field}}</ref>

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' {{1st}}
